activities.name: St_cleanup_project_null_values
activities.description:
Do the Project Number check to add '99'.
Replace NULL values for the following columns. MR description, Milestone Date and Plan_sub_type.

scripts.text:
UPDATE [gpd].[NCSA_procurement_status]
	SET Contract=CASE
					WHEN LEN(TRIM(Contract)) > 5 THEN '99'+TRIM(Contract)
				    ELSE TRIM(Contract)
	               END

--Defaulting NULL values since they are used as NK columns
update [gpd].[NCSA_procurement_status]
set milestone_date ='1900-01-01'
where milestone_date IS NULL

update [gpd].[NCSA_procurement_status]
set SubPlan_Type =''
where SubPlan_Type IS NULL

insert into [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data]
(ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE10,ATTRIBUTE11,ATTRIBUTE12,ATTRIBUTE13,ATTRIBUTE14,ATTRIBUTE15,ATTRIBUTE2,
ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,BILLABLE_FLAG,

select a.ATTRIBUTE1,a.ATTRIBUTE10,a.ATTRIBUTE11,a.ATTRIBUTE12,a.ATTRIBUTE13,a.ATTRIBUTE14,a.ATTRIBUTE15,a.ATTRIBUTE2,a.
ATTRIBUTE3,a.ATTRIBUTE4,a.ATTRIBUTE5,a.ATTRIBUTE6,a.ATTRIBUTE7,a.ATTRIBUTE8,a.ATTRIBUTE9,a.BILLABLE_FLAG,a.
CARRYING_OUT_ORGANIZATION_ID,a.CHARGEABLE_FLAG,a.COMPLETION_DATE,a.DESCRIPTION,a.ELEMENT_NUMBER,a.
LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.NAME,a.PROJECT_ID,a.PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,a.START_DATE,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data_stage] a,
(select PROJ_ELEMENT_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Project_Elements_Data_stage]
